title: Digital workflow optimization for complete mouth rehabilitation
html: Advancements in the accuracy of intraoral scanners and virtual patient simulation technologies have facilitated the reliable implementation of fully digital workflows for complex prosthodontic procedures, including complete mouth rehabilitation. Although numerous technologies and workflows have been introduced, some necessitate extensive armamentarium or additional procedural steps, thereby limiting their practical applicability. This video presentation outlines a relatively straightforward, yet predictable digital workflow designed for extensive fixed prosthodontic procedures in dentate patients.
